description: Move a sequence's playhead: by frames (Step Forward, Step Back), to the next or previous edit point (Go to Next/Previous Edit Point), gap (Sequence > Go To Gap) or marker (Markers > Go to Next/Previous Marker), or to the in or out point (Markers > Go to In, Go to Out). Edits and gaps are on every video and audio track unless track is given. Not an undo step

frames.description: With next_frame and previous_frame: how many frames. Default 1 (Shift steps 5)

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

track.description: Only clips on this kind of track (give with trackIndex); default every video and audio track

trackIndex.description: Only this track, 0 = V1 or A1 (with track)

name: move_playhead
title: Move Playhead
